show.description:
Love Cocktail is a bittersweet tale of love, sacrifice, and destiny. Aditya and Apoorva were once inseparable, bound by youthful passion and dreams of forever - until Apoorva suddenly walked away, shattering his heart. What Aditya never knew was that she was drowning in turmoil: abandoned by her father, burdened with a bankrupt company, and threatened by lawsuits. To protect him, she chose silence, masking her love as rejection.
Years later, Aditya, now a powerful CEO, crosses paths with Apoorva when she unknowingly seeks a job in his company. Cold on the surface but protective in secret, he hides his feelings while she silently battles both her past and her illness. Deepak, her steadfast friend, supports her but recognizes her heart still belongs to Aditya.
But when the truth surfaces, will Aditya forgive her silence?  Can love heal years of heartbreak? Or  will fate serve them one last bitter twist?

Watch “Love Cocktail” Micro Drama Series only on KUKU TV.
